perks.name: Behemoth
perks.definition: Enemy: +1 Attack and +1 Firepower **per turn**. Player: when engaged, +1 Attack and +1 Firepower per turn, **cap +3**.

perks.name: First Strike / Preemptive
perks.definition: Attack first when engaged; if both have it, **player** goes first.

perks.name: Rage / Fury
perks.definition: +1 Firepower each time hit (including map weapons).

perks.name: Heavy Weapons
perks.definition: First attack in engagement **ignores** opponent evasion.

perks.name: Ion Weapon
perks.definition: Enemy: +1 vs aircraft; ignore base shield (not overcharge). Player: +1 vs aircraft; ignore enemy unit shields.

perks.name: Luck / Good Luck
perks.definition: Higher critical-hit rate (“fatality rate is high”).

perks.name: Overload
perks.definition: First attack opportunity spends **all** attacks at once.

perks.name: Protect / Protected
perks.definition: Ignore first damaging hit; does not block instant-kill (Thermal Imploder); ≠ shield layer.

perks.name: Recovery
perks.definition: Full HP at each turn start.

perks.name: Resurrection
perks.definition: After dying once and battle ends, respawn without this perk.

perks.name: Speed Acceleration
perks.definition: Advance **2** spaces per turn. Default on Probe Droid & Speeder Bike.

perks.name: Squad Leader
perks.definition: Enemy: spawn with +1 extra unit. **Player: after battle, draw a new star card.**

perks.name: Important Goal
perks.definition: Must attack the unit with this perk.
